newsitem.title: GERMANY: German FDP politician sees EMU starting on time.
newsitem.headline: German FDP politician sees EMU starting on time.

text.p: The parliamentary group leader of Germany's liberal Free Democrats (FDP), Hermann Otto Solms, said on Monday he expected European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) to start as scheduled on January 1, 1999.

Solms told a financial market conference in Frankfurt that all major political parties expected a punctual launch of the single currency. The FDP is the junior coalition partner to Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats.

The management board chairman of stock exchange holding company Deutsche Boerse AG, Werner Seifert, said the bourse was preparing for a punctual EMU start but added that he was concerned the new currency may not be stable enough. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
